title: Paradise Boat Tours of lake havasu
specs: Topock Gorge called mini Grand Canyon with amazing rock formations
Wildlife sightings include Big horn sheep, coyotes, wild burros, beavers, raccoons
Copper Canyon has colorful rock formations from old copper mine
Must be 21 or older with valid ID to consume alcohol onboard
Safe for kids, life preservers provided
Boat fits up to 6 passengers per tour

blurb: Guests take guided boat tours on Lake Havasu and the Colorado River, including scenic areas like Topock Gorge and Copper Canyon. Tours range from short cruises to full-day experiences, with opportunities to see wildlife and learn about local history. Boats provide amenities like ice chests, towels, and Bluetooth stereo systems.
extraNote: Captain enforces safety and behavior policies; inappropriate behavior may result in early termination without refund
